prompts: Break their legs...
What wretched fate awaits you?
Maybe you can finally die...
The dice rattle like teeth in a skull...
Nechrubel watches with hollow eyes...
Spit blood and tempt the dark...
Will your bones hold this time?
Pray to a god that already rotted...
The grave is open. Step closer...
One slip and the worms feast...
Clutch your rusted iron and hope...
Even the rats expect you to fail...
Let the Basilisk weigh your miserable soul...
Your luck died in Galgenbeck...
Breathe the ash and swing...
A coward's prayer on cracked lips...
The gallows creak your name...
Bleed for nothing, die for less...
Count your fingers while you still have them...
Nothing good comes from this...
The dark leans in to watch you fall...
Tempt the Seventh Seal...
Your mother wept for nothing...
Hear the flies gather?
Steel meets bone. Whose?
Another step toward the mass grave...
Laugh at the end, or choke on it...
Fate is a drunkard with a dull knife...
Swallow the bile and roll...
The mud hungers for fresh meat...
No mercy in Bergen Chrypt...
Your name will be forgotten by dawn...
One more scar for the crows...
Hold your breath. The rot is listening...
You were born in filth; die in it...
The Shadow King smiles at your folly...
Test your miserable flesh...
See if the Pale Ones care...
The cold creeps into your marrow...
A dead saint won't save you now...
Strike before your hands shake...
The abyss blinks first? Never...
Spend your blood cheaply...
Every breath is stolen time...
Let the numbers seal your coffin...
Even silver can't buy you out of this...
The wind from Sarkash smells of you...
Choke on the soot and try anyway...
Your shadow already abandoned you...
Flesh is paper. Blades are ink...
Drop the bones and face the rot...
A desperate lunge in the dark...
The Inquisition loves a broken neck...
How much pain can one ribcage hold?
The calendar ticks closer to 7:7...
Trust your instinct—it's all that's left...
Perhaps the worms will be gentle...
Grit your rotting teeth...
Another gamble with a crooked die...
The floor is slick with someone else's blood...
Will the darkness spit you back out?
Anthelia drains the warmth from your veins...
King Fathmu's taxmen take less than this...
A whisper from Graven-Tosk...
Your torch gutters. Move...
Feel the noose tighten...
No heroics. Just survival...
Let the iron decide...
The crypts remember your scent...
A twitch of muscle, a crack of bone...
Roll before your courage curdles...
The Endless Sea claims all fools eventually...
What lies beneath the stone?
Don't look down. It's already there...
One last spasm before the quiet...
The plague rats are betting against you...
Your armor is thin as parchment...
Carve your survival out of meat...
A foul omen hangs in the rafters...
The dead don't miss. Do you?
Shake the cup like a beggar's bowl...
Silence waits on the other side of a 1...
Hope is a disease. Cure it...
The cliff at Terion looks kinder than this...
Bleed on the altar and see what answers...
Your lungs burn with grave-dust...
A clumsy swing could be your last...
The crooked crown demands a toll...
Something scratches inside the coffin...
Let fate twist the knife...
You've survived worse. Barely...
The stars above Cube-Violet laugh...
One breath. One roll. One mistake...
Drag your broken body forward...
The hounds smell your fear...
Even a goblin could end you here...
Cold sweat on a blistered palm...
May the die land kindly—it won't...
Feed the dark another story...
Crack your knuckles and tempt ruin...
The veil thins. Step through...
Not dead yet. Fix that?
A bitter wind blows through your ribs...
Show the world how cheaply you break...
Let the dice fall where the corpses lie...
